evals.name: four-problems-invoicer
evals.prompt: This is a snapshot of our invoicer repo. First run `bash make_history.sh` to restore its git history (the script deletes itself). Get this repo all right in one pass: whatever is missing, wrong, noisy or hard for an agent to find, fix what the repo itself can prove and list what needs a person. Work on a branch and commit as you go (pass -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@example.com to git if it has no identity). There is no remote and no gh, so save the pull request body you would open to .repo-health/PR.md. Do not deploy anything and do not ask questions.
evals.expected_output: One branch named repo-health/..., one commit per phase (chore(bus-factor|consistency|declutter|optimization): ...), no BUS-FACTOR.md or DECLUTTER-AUDIT.md at the root, a PR body at .repo-health/PR.md with a section per phase, questions for Dave and a judgment-calls list. Bus factor: all four env vars and the SSM sources documented, FIN-212 and the 300 req/min reasons recovered from history, /home/dave gone from deploy.sh, README no longer routes through Dave, RETRY_LIMIT asked not invented. Consistency: make check defined or removed, the docs/deploy.md link fixed, the duplicated how-it-works paragraph in one place, the commented-out push_legacy block and the TODO gone. Declutter: the History section's narrative gone from the README (into a commit body), ROUND_HALF_EVEN and the SSM paths kept. Optimization: an AGENTS.md within budget with CLAUDE.md = @AGENTS.md, every Makefile target still reachable. Tests pass.

evals.name: healthy-repo-restraint
evals.prompt: This is a snapshot of our payments-gateway repo. Run `git init -b main` and commit the snapshot first (pass -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@example.com to git if it has no identity). Then run a full repo-health pass and change whatever the repo actually needs, on a branch, committing as you go. Nothing may be lost and CI must keep doing everything it does today. There is no remote and no gh, so save the pull request body you would open to .repo-health/PR.md. Do not install anything, run nothing beyond git and python3, and do not ask questions.
evals.expected_output: Restraint: AGENTS.md already auto-loads, fits and is followed; commands have one home (the Makefile with make help); CI is real. The only change is one explicit route in AGENTS.md to docs/releasing.md, in a single chore(optimization) commit; every other file is byte-identical, no Taskfile, mise.toml, hooks or bootstrap appear, no root audit files, and the PR body marks bus-factor, consistency and declutter as skipped with the triage signals.
